_about: Corrections checked against street-level imagery (Jan 2026 captures on Street Number 2 and Street No. 13) and satellite views.
Points and outlines are in metres from the university's map pin: [east, north].
buildings: settings for the building whose outline contains `at`.
split: replace an outdated OpenStreetMap outline with parts along its long side (t = 0 at the west end, 1 at the east end).
add: outlines missing from both OpenStreetMap and Overture, traced by eye from satellite imagery. Approximate to a few metres.
Floor counts are estimates from street-level imagery or roof views; styles name the facade materials in public/world.js.
Names: map labels cross-checked with OpenStreetMap and Overture places. Unnamed buildings take the name of the one confident Overture place inside them, when there is exactly one.
drop: OpenStreetMap ways to leave out. construction: replaces OpenStreetMap's construction areas (empty: the old one now holds the EcoCentre, and the corner lot is open ground with trees).
